incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: metering-aggregator reports token_count drift (6.8%) vs baseline in 15m window. 12 customers flagged with potential overage. Pager routed to #incidents and @oncall-anna

oncall-anna: ACK. I'm online and looking. tagging @sre-miguel

sre-miguel: joining — pulling emitter logs and kafka offsets now

billing-elena: seeing 3 Zendesk tickets already mentioning unexpected overage emails. holding next billing cycle until we confirm

dataops-raj: quick check, running local aggregation query — might be duplicate replay from a backfill consumer

dataops-raj: ```sql
SELECT emitter_id, count(*) as tokens, window
FROM metering.events
WHERE ts >= now() - interval '20 minutes'
GROUP BY emitter_id, window
ORDER BY tokens DESC
LIMIT 10;
```

eng-ops: if it's a replay, we should stop the consumer and pause overage flags. can someone toggle feature flag for billing.overage_flag_enable?

oncall-anna: proposal: set billing.overage_flag_enable=false for 30m, cancel any immediate charge runs, and start a guarded replay scrub. @billing-elena ok? :thinking_face:

billing-elena: yes please mute flags. I'll open a hold on account actions and draft customer comms. :white_check_mark:

sre-miguel: I see repeated consumer group commit failures at offset 1245012 -> 1245001 causing duplicate reads. applying consumer pause now.

incident-bot: ACTION: feature-flag toggle applied by oncall-anna. billing.overage_flag_enable = false (applied at 1765432160).

eng-ops: thanks. also bumped emitter dedupe window to 120s as temporary guard (pushed config).

dataops-raj: post-mitigation quick stats: top emitter before = 1.2M tokens/15m, after pause = 120k tokens/15m. looks like replay accounted for ~90% of excess.

customer-success-hannah: prepping a short note to affected customers: "We detected a metering anomaly that may have flagged overages; we've paused billing flags while we investigate and will not charge for suspected duplicate usage." will share draft in #customer-comm

product-liz: good move. timeline capture: please GH-issue the incident timeline + queries used. we'll want this for postmortem and rollback guardrails. :notebook_with_decorative_cover:

oncall-anna: logging actions: pause consumer (1765432175), toggle flag (1765432160), config bump (1765432190). moving to monitoring mode for 30m. if counts remain stable after 20m we can start controlled replays with strict dedupe.

sre-miguel: monitoring dashboards show token rate back to baseline; no further overflag alerts in last 4m. continuing to watch.

billing-elena: I've canceled pending invoice triggers for affected accounts and flagged them for manual review. will follow up with CS on who to contact.

incident-bot: NOTE: no customer charges observed yet for flagged accounts. automated charge job scheduled in 2h has been disabled for affected prefixes.

customer-success-hannah: draft shared in #customer-comm, tagging legal for wording. cc @product-liz

oncall-anna: moving thread to #postmortems once monitoring window ends. initial mitigation worked; next steps: root-cause RCA (consumer checkpoint handling), improve dedupe, add metric for commit-rollback spikes. :thumbsup:

sre-miguel: I'll capture logs and produce a timeline snippet for RCA. thanks everyone for quick responses.

billing-elena: +1. will prepare refund playbook if any legacy charges slip through.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATED: mitigation applied, monitoring in progress. If new alerts fire, will re-pager the oncall rotation.
